headline: Weekend kits. Team hotel blocks when they’re posted.
rules: Dates on the calendar are game days.
Arrive the night before unless the event says you can drive in that morning.
Book the team hotel link. This is stay-to-play.
hotels: East Coast, Starz Gold, Sunshine, Scenic City, and Lone Star hotel blocks are posted. ACFL when the block is sent.

elon-team-camp-2026.ballparkNote: On Williamson Avenue across from Rhodes Stadium. I-85/40 Exit 140 (University Drive).
elon-team-camp-2026.mapCaption: Hunt Softball Park and the food stops.

foodNearPark.name: Pandora's Pies
foodNearPark.why: Same street as the park. Pizza. Smitty's ice cream is in the building.

foodNearPark.name: Skid's Restaurant
foodNearPark.why: Closest diner to campus. Saturday breakfast all day. Closes 2pm.

hotDog.name: Zack's Hot Dogs
hotDog.why: Burlington landmark since 1928. Short drive from the park.

memorable.name: The Root Trackside
memorable.why: Downtown Elon. Burgers and a kids menu. Open Saturday.

east-coast-fall-showcase-2026.ballparkNote: East Coast lists this complex. We will update if 16U is assigned to another field.
east-coast-fall-showcase-2026.mapCaption: Hotel, ballpark, and food. I-295 across the Delaware Memorial Bridge.
east-coast-fall-showcase-2026.routeNote: Hotel is in Newark, DE. Complex is in Pennsville, NJ. Route is I-295 across the Delaware Memorial Bridge. Check traffic before you leave.

foodNearHotel.name: Firebirds Wood Fired Grill
foodNearHotel.why: Next to the hotel. Kids menu.

foodNearPark.name: Italian Kitchen
foodNearPark.why: Family shop on Hook Road — pizza, subs, bakery. Short drive from the complex.

hotDog.name: Deerhead Hot Dogs
hotDog.why: Same plaza as the hotel. Wilmington dogs since 1935. Get the sauce.

memorable.name: The Engine House
memorable.why: Just north of the bridge. Short rib, sliders, golf simulators. The night-out stop.

starz-gold-fall-2026.ballparkNote: Starz Gold also lists Dorey Park, Glen Allen, and LC Bird. We will update if 16U is assigned to another field.
starz-gold-fall-2026.mapCaption: Hotel in Chester, Diamonds at Iron Bridge, and food on Iron Bridge Road.
starz-gold-fall-2026.routeNote: Hotel is on West Hundred in Chester. Complex is Iron Bridge on Whitepine.

foodNearPark.name: Dante's of Ironbridge
foodNearPark.why: Family Italian on Iron Bridge Road. Pizza, pasta, kids eat here.

foodNearPark.name: Brock's Barbeque
foodNearPark.why: On the same road as the complex. Pulled pork, and they grill a dog.

acfl-fall-championship-2026.ballparkNote: ACFL also lists LC Bird. We will update if 16U is assigned to another field.

foodNearPark.name: Dante's of Ironbridge

scenic-city-fall-2026.ballparkNote: Connect Sports splits games across Camp Jordan, Warner Park, Summit of Softball, and fields in Cleveland, Ooltewah, and Dalton. We will update when 16U is assigned.
scenic-city-fall-2026.mapCaption: Walker hotel in Cleveland. Camp Jordan is one of the complexes.
scenic-city-fall-2026.routeNote: Hotel is in Cleveland. Camp Jordan is in East Ridge. Games may also be at Warner Park, Summit, Ooltewah, or Dalton.

foodNearPark.name: Champy's Famous Fried Chicken
foodNearPark.why: Closest sit-down to Camp Jordan. Fried chicken, kids menu.

hotDog.name: Miss Griffin's Foot Long Hot Dogs
hotDog.why: Chattanooga dogs since 1939. Eastgate Town Center food court. Mustard, hot sauce, onions, secret relish.

memorable.name: Aretha Frankenstein's
memorable.why: North Shore. Pancakes. The morning-after-games stop if you stay.

top-gun-lone-star-fall-2026.ballparkNote: Where Lone Star has been in Grapevine. We will update if 2026 fall uses another complex.
top-gun-lone-star-fall-2026.mapCaption: Hotel in Fort Worth. Oak Grove and downtown Grapevine.
top-gun-lone-star-fall-2026.routeNote: Hotel is on Vickery in Fort Worth. Complex is Oak Grove in Grapevine.

foodNearPark.name: Tolbert's Restaurant
foodNearPark.why: Downtown Grapevine. Chili parlor. Short drive from Oak Grove.

memorable.name: Winewood Grill
memorable.why: Main Street sit-down. Steak, seafood, kids can eat here too.
